1. $\theta_t=\theta_{t-1}-\eta g_t$.
2. A velocity / exponentially weighted sum of past gradients (direction memory).
3. $\sqrt{r_t}+\varepsilon$, where $r_t$ is an EMA of squared gradients (elementwise).
4. $\theta_t=\theta_{t-1}-\eta\,\hat{m}_t/(\sqrt{\hat{v}_t}+\varepsilon)$ with $\hat{m}_t=m_t/(1-\beta_1^t)$, $\hat{v}_t=v_t/(1-\beta_2^t)$.
5. About $(0.9,0.999)$.
